annotations.title: Get a QR code for a link

description: Read-only. A print-ready QR code for a link, in the workspace's QR style (Dashboard → Settings → QR codes); the options override it for this one code, or pass preset to use a saved style (get_workspace lists them). Returns the image (PNG, or SVG markup) and the exact URL in the code. By default scans add utm_source=qr, so they show as the qr channel in analytics. Refused (400) if the colours have under 3:1 contrast.

background.description: Background colour as hex, e.g. ffffff

logo.description: Put the app icon in the middle (default: the workspace setting)

preset.description: A saved QR style (its id from get_workspace qrStyles); color, background and logo still override it

size.description: Width and height in pixels, default 512

slug.description: The link's slug: the part after the link domain, e.g. `summer` in https://hilltop.strait.link/summer

track.description: Add utm_source=qr so scans count as the qr channel (default true)

name: get_link_qr
title: Get a QR code for a link
